description: This Java class implements a Spring Batch Tasklet that processes queued external events, sends them via external producers (e.g., JMS or Kafka), and marks them as sent in the database. It handles batching, parallel processing, and message serialization.

classes.name: SendAsynchronousEventsTasklet
classes.description: A Spring Batch Tasklet responsible for fetching queued external events, sending them through appropriate external message producers, and marking them as sent in the repository. Implements parallel processing and batching to handle large volumes efficiently.

methods.name: execute
methods.description: Main method invoked during batch job execution; it coordinates event retrieval, sending, and error handling.

methods.name: isDownstreamChannelEnabled
methods.description: Checks if external event channels (JMS or Kafka) are enabled based on configuration.

methods.name: getQueuedEventsBatch
methods.description: Retrieves a batch of events pending to be sent, using pagination for batch size control.

methods.name: sendEvents
methods.description: Handles the process of partitioning events, sending them via the producer, and marking them as sent.

methods.name: sendEventsToProducer
methods.description: Invokes the external event producer to send messages based on prepared partitions.

methods.name: markEventsAsSent
methods.description: Partitions event IDs and updates their status to 'sent' in the database, using parallel tasks for efficiency.

methods.name: generatePartitions
methods.description: Creates message partitions grouped by aggregate root ID, encoding event data into byte arrays.

methods.name: createMessages
methods.description: Serializes a list of external events into byte arrays using message factory and byte buffer conversion.

methods.name: getBatchSize
methods.description: Retrieves the batch size configuration for external events.
